import pathlib
wd=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485492/attempts/9f509ca37a0f4b279e3de00a5074f14c/system/state/workspace')
programs=wd/'programs'; programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    def spans(n, cuts):
        bounds = [-1] + cuts + [n]
        return [(bounds[i] + 1, bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(bounds) - 1)]
    row_spans = spans(h, sep_rows)
    col_spans = spans(w, sep_cols)
    cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if r not in sep_rows and c not in sep_cols]
    background = max(set(cells), key=cells.count)
    marker = max((x for x in set(cells) if x != background),
                 key=lambda x: cells.count(x))
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c] == marker
                      for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)) >= 2
             else background
             for c0, c1 in col_spans]
            for r0, r1 in row_spans]
'''
